CFML Language Reference: Functions

BitMaskRead

Extracts length bits from the number, starting at bit start (bit 0 is the lowest), and returns them as an integer shifted down to bit 0.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

BitMaskRead(number, start, length)

Parameters

number
A 32-bit integer.
start
Position of the lowest bit to read, 0 to 31.
length
Number of bits to read, 1 to 31.

Returns

A non-negative integer between 0 and 2^length - 1.

Usage

Useful for unpacking several small values stored in one integer column, a favorite space-saving trick from the days when a 1 GB disk was big. BitMaskSet packs them in again.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- Pack a date into one integer: day in bits 0-4, month in bits 5-8, year offset in bits 9-15 --->
<CFSET Packed = 31 + 12 * 32 + 99 * 512>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Packed value: #Packed# (binary <TT>#FormatBaseN(Packed, 2)#</TT>)
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Field</TH><TH>Call</TH><TH>Value</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>Day</TD><TD><TT>BitMaskRead(Packed, 0, 5)</TT></TD><TD>#BitMaskRead(Packed, 0, 5)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Month</TD><TD><TT>BitMaskRead(Packed, 5, 4)</TT></TD><TD>#BitMaskRead(Packed, 5, 4)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Year - 1900</TD><TD><TT>BitMaskRead(Packed, 9, 7)</TT></TD><TD>#BitMaskRead(Packed, 9, 7)#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
